name: 罗隐
habitat: 风眠圣所 / 拉布朗矿山附近捕捉（阿米亚特进化）
habitatEn: Fengmian Sanctum / Labulang Mine (evolves from Amiyate)
evolution: 阿米亚特 → 阿米樱（Lv30）→ 罗隐（Lv50）→ 深渊罗隐（首领血脉）
evolutionEn: Amiyate → Amiying (Lv30) → Luoyin (Lv50) → Abyss Luoyin (Alpha Blood)
description: 地/恶双系物攻战神，物攻资质全图鉴顶级。特性「石头大餐」能量不足时消耗 5% 生命代替 1 点能量，配合「贪婪」100% 吸血形成掉血-吸血永动循环，PVE 万金油、首领战主力。
descriptionEn: A Ground/Dark physical juggernaut with top-tier ATK stats. Its "Stone Feast" trait spends 5% HP in place of 1 energy when short, and with Greed's 100% lifesteal it forms an infinite drain loop — a PVE all-rounder and boss-fight staple.

skills.name: 魔爪
skills.description: 造成物伤，自身回复 1 点能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage and restores 1 energy.

skills.name: 钧势
skills.descriptionEn: Raises own DEF by 140%, lowers SPD by 30.

skills.name: 鸣沙陷阱
skills.description: 造成物伤，自身物防比敌方越高威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage that scales with your DEF advantage.

skills.name: 力量吞噬
skills.description: 敌方全技能威力 -20，自身全技能威力 +20。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy skills lose 20 power; own skills gain 20.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击 1 次本技能能耗永久 -1。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage; each hit taken permanently reduces this skill's cost.

skills.name: 砂石冲撞
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵则自身物防 +100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage; gains +100% DEF if the enemy swaps this turn.

skills.name: 泥浆铠甲
skills.description: 自身物攻和物防 +60%，应对防御时增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Raises ATK and DEF by 60%; doubles when countering Defense.

skills.name: 暗突袭
skills.description: 造成物伤并吸血 50%，应对状态时威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage with 50% lifesteal; doubles vs status.
